name: paint-gradient-space
_comment: CSS Images 4 gradient interpolation. Omitting `in oklch` blends #e23a3a to #2e6eee in premultiplied sRGB, so the midpoint is the muddy purple (136, 84, 148) instead of the oklch mix. `in hsl longer hue` walks the long way around the hue circle. pixel_tolerance 1 absorbs the same dither as paint-gradient. #plain has no interpolation method.
